In the 2014 season, three drivers won at least one race: Lewis Hamilton (11 wins), Nico Rosberg (5) and Daniel Ricciardo (3). The 2014 final standings give these counts, and they add up to 19 wins, which matches the 19 races on the calendar. The Mercedes total of 16 (11 + 5) and the Red Bull total of 3 also agree with the constructors' table. None of the other drivers in the standings has a win.

ANSWER: 3
